# OpenCC character mapping

TSCharacters.txt and LICENSE are from [BYVoid/OpenCC](https://github.com/BYVoid/OpenCC), revision `3ac34aa439a9908dd49fa92b5174b46314787ac2`. The table is used only to compare Chinese song metadata, never to rewrite displayed lyrics. Character-level normalization avoids bundling a full document-conversion engine and phrase dictionaries.
